# bugs #3286: mcs51: internal error in getFreePtr for casts of a 64-bit stack parameter with --stack-auto

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3286/
- Category: [Fixes](../../fix.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17200
- Recommended action: Apply the patch and close.
- Patch: [bugs-3286.patch](../../patches/bugs-3286.patch), commit [`b588af889`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/b588af889f036da0dcf328509d6186f7889e3772). Applies to r17200 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

With `--stack-auto` the compiler stops at the function `func_0_ng` from the ticket's description
with the internal error `getFreePtr should never reach here`. This was reproduced on r17158, with
and without `__banked`. Both inner `if` statements are needed. With either one alone the function
compiles.

## Cause

`serialRegAssign` and `fillGaps` in `src/mcs51/ralloc.c` give the result of a `CAST` the registers
that `regs[]` of its operand names. `spilSomething` frees the registers of the symbol that it
spills and leaves the entries in `regs[]`. After the spill those entries name registers that the
symbol does not own. The code for the `CAST` passes them to `allocThisReg` directly. `getRegGpr`
and `getRegGprNoSpil` allocate r0 and r1 only while `mcs51_ptrRegReq` is zero, and the direct call
omits that test.

In the ticket's function the result of the cast from the 64-bit stack parameter receives r0 to r3.
No pointer register remains to address the parameter on the stack, and `getFreePtr` in
`src/mcs51/gen.c` reports the internal error.

## Fix

Both functions skip this step when the operand has `isspilt` set. The result of the cast then
receives its registers from `getRegGpr` or `getRegGprNoSpil`.

## Verification

`tests/bug-3286.c` contains the ticket's function without `__banked` and checks its results.
Without the patch the test does not compile for mcs51-small-stack-auto and mcs51-large-stack-auto.
With the patch it passes for both.
